title: Developer Tools & Integrations
summary: This module provides a comprehensive suite of tools and integrations for developers to build, test, and extend LangChain applications, encompassing evaluation frameworks, external partner connections, agent enhancements, and general utilities.

nodes.label: LangChain Application
nodes.title: User's LangChain Application
nodes.description: The primary application built by developers using the LangChain framework, which consumes the functionalities provided by this module.

nodes.label: Evaluation & Testing Framework
nodes.title: LLM Evaluation & Testing
nodes.description: Provides tools and methodologies for assessing the performance, correctness, and robustness of LLMs, agents, and chains.

nodes.label: External Partner Integrations
nodes.title: Third-Party Service Connectivity
nodes.description: Enables seamless connection and interaction with a wide array of external AI services, including LLMs, embedding models, and vector stores from various providers.

nodes.label: Agent Middleware & Control
nodes.title: Agent Behavior Enhancement
nodes.description: Offers a collection of middleware components to modify, enhance, and control the behavior of agents, including features like PII handling, call limiting, and human-in-the-loop capabilities.

nodes.label: General Developer Utilities
nodes.title: Common Helper Functions
nodes.description: Contains a diverse set of general-purpose utilities such as text splitting, output parsing, serialization, and dynamic module loading, supporting various development tasks.

groups.label: Core Development Lifecycle
groups.title: Core Development Lifecycle Tools
groups.description: Tools essential for the development, testing, and maintenance phases of building LangChain applications, including evaluation and general-purpose utilities.

groups.label: Agent Behavior Enhancement
groups.title: Agent Behavior Enhancement
groups.description: Components specifically designed to extend and control the operational aspects and interactions of AI agents within the framework.

groups.label: External Ecosystem Access
groups.title: External Ecosystem Access
groups.description: Integrations facilitating connectivity and interoperability with a broad range of third-party AI services and platforms.
